description: This file defines extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add and configure log storage-based log consistency providers in an Orleans silo. It provides methods to add these providers with default or custom names, and internal methods to modify the IServiceCollection for dependency injection.

classes.name: LogStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add log storage log consistency providers.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a log storage-based log consistency provider as the default for the silo.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a log storage-based log consistency provider with an optional name parameter.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method that configures IServiceCollection to add log storage log consistency provider with a specific name.
